cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.31)
project(mantle_native_fixture VERSION 1.0 LANGUAGES C CXX)
add_library(answer STATIC answer.c answer.cpp)
if(NOT DEFINED FIXTURE_OFFSET)
  set(FIXTURE_OFFSET 0)
endif()
target_compile_definitions(answer PRIVATE FIXTURE_OFFSET=${FIXTURE_OFFSET})
set_target_properties(answer PROPERTIES CXX_STANDARD 17)
target_compile_options(answer PRIVATE -fno-stack-protector -fno-builtin
  $<$<COMPILE_LANGUAGE:CXX>:-fno-exceptions;-fno-rtti>)
add_executable(answer-bin entry.c)
target_compile_options(answer-bin PRIVATE -fno-stack-protector -fno-builtin)
target_link_options(answer-bin PRIVATE -nostdlib -static -Wl,--build-id=none)
target_link_libraries(answer-bin PRIVATE answer)
install(TARGETS answer answer-bin ARCHIVE DESTINATION lib RUNTIME DESTINATION bin)
install(FILES answer.h DESTINATION include)
# Exercise forwarding of file() strings/list values without argument corruption.
file(WRITE "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/list.txt" "one;two\n")
file(READ "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/list.txt" value)
if(NOT value STREQUAL "one;two\n")
  message(FATAL_ERROR "file() forwarding corrupted list content")
endif()
